strings.subtitle: — Umusenya w'inyandiko —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Gukurura no kureka ntibiboneka. Koresha buto yo hepfo.
strings.ssd_warning:
Iburira! Kuri SSD, uburyo bwo kwandika hejuru ntibwemeza gusenya kubera TRIM.
Iyi porogaramu ni iya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Inyandiko "{name}" izokwandikwa hejuru kandi isibwe.

Komeza?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Iyi ni shortcut (.lnk). Shortcut gusa ni yo izosamburwa.

Idosiye igamije yerekana izoguma ari nzima.

Ukomeza?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Iyi ni network drive (\\server\share).
Kwandika hejuru y'ibice nta garantie itanga — server ishobora kugira snapshot, deduplication canke CoW.

Ukomeza?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Iyi ni removable drive (USB / HDD yo hanze).
Controller ishobora kubika amabuye ashaje mu bubiko.

Ukomeza?
strings.report_limits:
• Imigezi y'amakuru y'ubundi buryo ya NTFS (ADS) ntiraba.
• Ikinyamakuru USN nticyisukurwa.
• Kopi z'igicucu n'ihuza ry'ibicu
  (OneDrive n'ibindi) ntibigira ingaruka.
strings.status_full: Ibiri muri inyandiko byanditswe hejuru rwose ku busa. Gusubiza ntibishoboka — ibikoresho bizobona gusa ubusa.
strings.status_fast: Umutwe, umurizo n'imirongo 4 MB byanditswe hejuru. Ibisigaye ntibyakozweho, ariko kubera umwanya, gusubiza byuzuye n'ibikoresho by'abakoresha ntibishoboka. Ku nyandiko z'ibanga koresha uburyo BWUZUYE.
strings.status_empty: Inyandiko yari ubusa, kwandika hejuru ntibyari ngombwa. Yasibwe.
strings.error_permission: Ntishobora gushika ku dosiye. Ishobora kuba ifunguye muri programi indi. Funga hanyuma ugerageze.
strings.error_is_symlink: Iyi ni symbolic link. Links ntizishobora gusamburwa — idosiye igamije izoguma ari nzima.
strings.error_reparse: Iyi ni dosiye placeholder (OneDrive canke nkayo). Amakuru yayo ari mu bicu, atari kuri disiki — nta kintu co gusambura ngaha.
strings.error_not_file: Iyi ntiy'idosiye (ububiko canke ikindi). Manuka idosiye.
strings.error_hardlinks: Iyi dosiye ifise izindi hard link ({n} zose). Hard links ntizifise iya mbere — amazina yose aranga. Nimba usambura mu nzira iriho, amakuru azandikwa hejuru hanyuma agabanywe kugeza kuri 32 bytes, ariko ibisigaye bizoshikika binyuze mu zindi links. Siba links zose mbere.
strings.error_compressed:
Idosiye irakomwe, irashizwemwo ibanga canke irapfuye. Kwandika zero nta garantie itanga yo gusambura amakuru ashaje kuko NTFS iyabika mu bundi buryo.

Kuraho ikimenyetso: kanda iburyo → Ivyerekeye → Biteye imbere → ukure 'Kompress' na/canke 'Encrypt'. Hanyuma ukoreshe SHREDDER.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Dosiye {count} zirazasamburwa.
Ingano yose: {size}.

Raba urutonde mbere yo gukomeza.
Iki gikorwa ntigishobora gusubizwa.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Kuraho dosiye zose {count} mu murongo?

Dosiye ubwazo NTIZIZAKORWAKO — urutonde gusa.
strings.hardlink_text:
Idosiye "{name}" ifise izindi hard link ({nlink} zose).

Amakuru azasamburwa ku mazina yose.
Ariko ibisigaye (32 bytes) bizoguma munsi y'ayandi mazina mu bubiko.

Ushobora kuzokenera gusiba ibi bisigaye n'intoki.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Shira mu bikorwa kuri hard link zose mu murongo
